component.name: Image
component.description: An image slot that keeps a set aspect ratio and shows a neutral placeholder while there is no source.

useWhen: Any layout slot that holds a course image, banner, or visual media
A card thumbnail — pass src when available, omit for the placeholder state
Hero or wide banner sections using a landscape aspect ratio

notFor.case: Using Image for avatar or user profile pictures
notFor.because: Avatar handles circular crop, initials fallback, and size tokens specific to user imagery.

useWhen.1/1: Small course slots and CardHorizontal thumbnails. Square.
useWhen.16/9: Video thumbnails, wide course banners and hero images. Landscape.
useWhen.4/5: Tall card images, as in CardVertical size lg. Portrait.
